name: Sodhani Academy of Fintech Enablers Ltd
about: Founded in 2019, Sodhani Academy of Fintech Enablers Limited offers financial training, consulting and learning services.[1]
keyPoints: Business Profile[1] The company focuses on financial education and awareness, aiming to enhance knowledge and understanding of financial concepts. This includes effective money management, budgeting, saving, investing, and understanding basic financial products and services

pros: Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 63.6 days to 25.7 days
cons: Stock is trading at 9.81 times its book value
Earnings include an other income of Rs.2.77 Cr.
